4279-5708-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5708-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4302-5929-8095.description:

When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

122-328-2732-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
